AN351/RE350
Forbidden Language
0.5 Credit
Hours per week:
Lecture/Discussion: 3
An examination of language, belief, and social power through the topic of taboo language.
We explore the sometimes-insidious cultural, religious, and psycho-social power of bad,
impure, or "dirty" words, from profanities and sacrilegious curses, blasphemous speech,
swears, censoring, slurs, and slip-ups, to forbidden topics,
terms
, and forms.
